verdict.rationale: cubic runs built-in actions on fixed PR events: it reviews new PRs automatically, auto-approves PRs that meet a review policy, auto-resolves threads once issues are fixed, and checks PRs against linked Jira or Linear issues. Users can also define custom-agent review rules in cubic.yaml that apply across PRs. However, these are preset triggers tied to code review, not a general rule engine where users pick events and the actions they trigger. Missing for 10: user-configurable event-to-action rules beyond review behavior, webhooks or custom event triggers, actions outside the PR review flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
